<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm) are at 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm. Each of these appears twice, indicating two equivalent carbons for each chemical shift. Therefore the compound contains 6 × 2 = 12 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
